g1.label: 1. Where do most polar bears live?
g1.why: The text says more than two-thirds of the world's polar bears live in Canada.

g2.label: 2. Polar bear fur is actually ___
g2.why: The text says polar bear fur is actually transparent, not white.

g3.label: 3. The fat layer is called ___
g3.why: The text says the thick layer of fat that keeps polar bears warm is called blubber.

g4.label: 4. Detect prey from up to ___
g4.why: The text says polar bears can detect prey from up to 32km away.

g5.label: 5. The Arctic fox changes colour for ___
g5.why: The text says the Arctic fox changes its fur colour for camouflage.

g6.label: 6. "Canary of the sea" because of its ___
g6.why: The text says the beluga whale is called the 'canary of the sea' because of its sounds.

g7.label: 7. Climate change causes sea ice to ___
g7.why: The text says climate change causes Arctic sea ice to melt.

g8.label: 8. Fewer chances to ___
g8.why: The text says polar bears have fewer chances to hunt because of less sea ice.

g1.label: 1. Every winter, caribou ___
g1.why: ‘Every winter’ signals a habitual action, so the simple present ‘migrate’ is used.

g2.label: 2. "Look! A polar bear ___"
g2.why: ‘Look!’ signals something happening right now, so the present continuous ‘is swimming’ is used.

g3.label: 3. Students usually ___ school
g3.why: ‘Usually’ signals a habitual action, so the simple present ‘start’ is used.

g4.label: 4. Right now, scientists ___
g4.why: ‘Right now’ signals something happening at this moment, so the present continuous ‘are studying’ is used.

g5.label: 5. The Arctic fox ___ colour twice a year
g5.why: ‘Twice a year’ signals a habitual action, so the simple present ‘changes’ is used.

g6.label: 6. "It ___ heavily outside"
g6.why: The context (‘we can't go for a walk today’) signals something happening right now, so the present continuous ‘is snowing’ is used.

g7.label: 7. Many Canadians ___ outdoor activities
g7.why: A general truth about Canadians' habits uses the simple present ‘enjoy’.

g8.label: 8. Temperatures sometimes ___ below -50°
g8.why: ‘Sometimes… in winter’ signals a habitual/general truth, so the simple present ‘drop’ is used.

g1.label: 1. Ice hockey ___ the most popular sport
g1.why: ‘Since 1875’ signals an action continuing to now, so the present perfect ‘has become’ is used.

g2.label: 2. Athletes ___ many medals
g2.why: ‘Over the years’ signals an action continuing to now, so the present perfect ‘have won’ is used.

g3.label: 3. My cousin ___ ice hockey since he was five
g3.why: ‘Since he was five’ signals an action continuing to now, so the present perfect ‘has played’ is used.

g4.label: 4. The team ___ in every Olympics since 1998
g4.why: ‘Since 1998’ signals an action continuing to now, so the present perfect ‘has competed’ is used.

g5.label: 5. "I ___ curling"
g5.why: ‘Never’ with the present perfect describes an experience up to now.

g6.label: 6. Canada ___ the Winter Olympics twice
g6.why: ‘Twice so far’ signals an action continuing to now, so the present perfect ‘has hosted’ is used.

g7.label: 7. Millions of children ___ to skate
g7.why: ‘Over the decades’ signals an action continuing to now, so the present perfect ‘have learned’ is used.

g8.label: 8. Our school ___ a new club
g8.why: ‘Just’ with the present perfect shows something happened a very short time ago.
